title: Working Zones Introduction and Seal Ring's Housing
topics: Seal ring housing working zone introduction
Relief radius for seal ring seats
Bearing and seal ring assembly with same fitting diameter
rules: Relief radius R must be applied at seal ring housing working zone introduction
Relief radius R varies by diameter: ød ≤ 60 → R = 0.4 mm; ød > 60 ≤ 120 → R = 0.8 mm; ød > 120 → R = 1.2 mm
Minimum effective relief dimension a = 1 mm (minimum effective), use minimum value when dimensions don't allow larger relief (constraint: a ≥ 2 mm normally)
For bearing and seal ring with same fitting diameter (dc = da): seal ring assembly must be followed by bearing assembly
When bearing outer diameter equals seal ring fitting diameter, zone L on specific zones must remain the same and roughness useful length assigned
All zone L must be dimensioned on the drawing indicating the useful length of execution
Rounded edge (spigot arrotondato) or sharp edge (spigot tagliente) must be specified - sharp edges must be avoided
Surface with plunge grinding machining and without roughness a/o helical riflings must be indicated
dimensions: a = 1 mm minimum effective (normally a ≥ 2 mm)
Zone L must be specified and dimensioned on drawing
tolerances: Bearing fitting tolerance and roughness values must be indicated in zone L when dc = da
surface_finish: Roughness values must be specified in zone L
Surface possibly with plunge grinding machining and without roughness a/o helical riflings must be indicated with specific symbol
inspection: Verify relief radius R according to diameter range
Verify minimum effective dimension a ≥ 1 mm
Check that zone L is properly dimensioned on drawing
Verify rounded edge specification (spigot arrotondato e/o estremità arrotondata)
Confirm assembly sequence when dc = da (seal ring before bearing)
manufacturing_notes: Relief dimension a should normally be ≥ 2 mm, but minimum effective value is 1 mm when space is constrained
Sharp edges (spigot tagliente) must be avoided
Rounded edges or rounded extremities must be specified
Plunge grinding machining without helical riflings may be specified for certain surfaces
Assembly sequence is critical when bearing and seal ring share same fitting diameter
training_guidance: NX agent must create relief radius R at seal ring housing introduction based on diameter: 0.4 mm (d≤60), 0.8 mm (60<d≤120), 1.2 mm (d>120)
Model minimum effective relief length a = 1 mm, prefer a ≥ 2 mm when space permits
When bearing seat outer diameter equals seal ring seat diameter (dc = da), ensure zone L is modeled with consistent dimensions and mark for proper tolerancing
Apply rounded edge feature (fillet/chamfer) at seal seat entries; avoid sharp edges
Include zone L dimension annotation in drawing output with tolerance and roughness specifications
Flag assemblies where dc = da to enforce seal-then-bearing assembly sequence in manufacturing instructions
summary: This standard defines the geometric requirements for seal ring housing working zones, specifying diameter-dependent relief radii (R = 0.4/0.8/1.2 mm) and minimum relief length (a ≥ 1 mm effective). When bearing and seal ring share the same fitting diameter, special attention must be given to zone L dimensioning, assembly sequence (seal first, then bearing), and surface finish specifications. Rounded edges are mandatory and all critical dimensions must be clearly indicated on drawings.
